name: concise
description: Concise is a minimalist, self-hosted personal finance / net-worth tracker. One small Node.js process serves BOTH the web UI and the REST API from a single internal port — 3000 inside the container (there is no separate API port; the UI calls /api on the same port). Map a host port to container 3000 with "WebUI Port" below. All state is a single SQLite file; validated backups are written to the mapped backup directory. Set PUID/PGID to the user that owns your appdata share (Unraid: 99 / 100). Access over plain HTTP on your LAN requires COOKIE_SECURE=false (the template default); set it to true only when serving Concise behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (concise.db). Must be writable by PUID:PGID. Backups go to the separate 'Backup Directory' mapping below.

paths.name: Backup Directory
paths.description: Where validated database backups are written (automatic + manual). Point the host (left) side at any share you like — e.g. a dedicated backups share or a second disk — to keep copies off the database's own folder. The container side is fixed at /backups (the BACKUP_DIR variable points here). Must be writable by PUID:PGID.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port published for Concise. The container always listens on 3000 internally, serving BOTH the web UI and the /api REST API from that one port (there is no separate API port). Change the host (left) side only — leave the container side as 3000.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the appdata share. Unraid default is 99 (nobody). Files in /data are created as this user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the appdata share. Unraid default is 100 (users).

variables.name: COOKIE_SECURE
variables.description: Send session cookies only over HTTPS. Leave 'false' for plain-HTTP LAN access (e.g. http://tower:3000) or login will silently fail. Set 'true' ONLY when Concise is behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

variables.name: BACKUP_DIR
variables.description: Container path Concise writes backups to. Leave this as /backups — it must match the container side of the 'Backup Directory' volume above; change the HOST folder there to relocate backups, not this.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for log timestamps. Concise's own date calculations are always UTC, so this is cosmetic.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File-creation mask for the database and backups.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Number of reverse-proxy hops to trust for client IPs (rate limiting, audit log). Set to 1 behind a single proxy; 0 when exposed directly.

variables.name: TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated extra origins the CSRF check should trust (e.g. https://money.example.com). Only needed if the UI is served from a different origin than the API.

variables.name: API_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: Max API requests per client IP per minute.

variables.name: LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: Max login attempts per client IP per 15 minutes.

variables.name: PRICE_PROVIDER
variables.description: 'real' fetches live quotes from Yahoo Finance (no API key). 'simulated' uses a deterministic offline simulation (for air-gapped use; prices will not match the market).

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity (structured JSON to the container log): fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace, silent.

variables.name: SEED_ON_START
variables.description: Set to 1 to (re)create the demo account (demo / demo) on every start. Leave 0 for real use.
